name: Uranian-Fathom
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are acid rain regions, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.
Storm season reorganizes all plans. When the pressure falls, animals go quiet, instruments drift, and the horizon turns the color of an old wound.
Something about this world resists explanation. Every expedition answers three questions and returns with five better ones.
Whoever controls exotic matter controls the approach lanes. Three factions have done the arithmetic, and only two of them are being subtle about it.
